name: Cleopatra Gas Gathering System
researcher_notes: Existing operating offshore gas gathering line in the Gulf of Mexico, not on the GEM roster under any name (checked Nautilus, Garden Banks, Mississippi Canyon and the other offshore rows). An Enbridge offshore pipelines fact sheet says it is a 20-inch gathering line of 110 miles with 500 million cubic feet per day capacity, 22 percent owned by Enbridge and operated by Shell Pipeline. The Shell Midstream Partners 2016 annual report says 115 miles, so the two sources differ by 5 miles; 110 used as the current operator-side figure. Both are well over the 25 km floor. The 10-K shows connections at the Holstein platform in Southern Green Canyon, with laterals from Atlantis and Mad Dog, and a Ship Shoal terminus per a trade description; the exact end point is not confirmed by a primary document. Other owners per Shell Midstream: Shell Midstream 1 percent via Cleopatra Gas Gathering Company LLC, plus Mardi Gras, BHP, and Chevron entities; only Enbridge is staged as owner pending ownership-team review (Shell Pipeline Co is the team style if added). Gathering type is confirmed. Fuel entity Enbridge exists in the gazetteer. Route not researched; BOEM offshore pipeline GIS would be the first route source.
